info.title: Sanad complete API — legacy and account hiring platform
info.description: Desired implementation contract, not deployed backend. PLATFORM.md is normative for v2; CONTRACT.md documents backward compatible legacy /api. Client/account workflows use /api/v2; public discovery still uses existing /api. All private state belongs to authenticated user, never X-Device-ID. See SECURITY.md, NOTIFICATION-EVENTS.md and ACCEPTANCE-PLATFORM.md.
